correctness.rationale: The line-graph independent sets are precisely matchings of the bouquet. Hub-unmatched matchings factor as product of path polynomials p_{ℓ_i-1}; hub-matched matchings choose exactly one of two incident edges in exactly one cycle and yield 2z p_{ℓ_i-2} times the other factors. The p_m recurrence (p0=p1=1, p_m=p_{m-1}+z p_{m-2}) is exact. At z=-1, generating function (1+t)/(1+t^3) shows p_{ℓ-1}(-1)=0 iff 3|ℓ and the zero is simple, with derivative (-1)^(ℓ/3-1)ℓ/3 and neighbor path value (-1)^(ℓ/3-1). For c=0, the remaining factor is the nonzero odd integer (1-2b). For c≥1, the c terms at order c-1 contribute a same-signed positive sum of 1/k_i; no cancellation. Independent sympy polynomial reconstructions checked mixed/repeated cycle lengths and exact roots; source verifier independently constructs bouquet edge sets and tests 126 matching-polynomial coefficients, but only the algebraic argument proves all r and lengths.
